subject: READING
prompt: Word bank: moon, sun, fish. Type the words that fit. The ___ is up in the sky. It gives us light during the day. At night, we see the ___ and the stars.
explanation: The sun gives light during the day. At night we see the moon and the stars. A fish is not in the sky.

subject: READING
prompt: Read: Kim got out of bed. She ate an egg. Then she got on the bus. At school, she said hi to her friend. Put the events in order.
orderedItems: Kim said hi to her friend.
explanation: The story tells the events in this order: out of bed, ate an egg, got on the bus, said hi at school. (Retelling events in order from a short text the child can see is an early, EASY version of this skill.)
